mapper.select: SELECT plan_batch.id, plan_batch.preparation_quantity, plan_batch.formula_material_id, plan_batch.unit_id, plan_batch.material_batch_id, plan_batch.material_batch_no, measure_batch.measure_status, formula_material.material_name, formula_material.material_merge_code FROM bm_liquid_preparation_plan_material_batch plan_batch LEFT JOIN bm_liquid_preparation_measure_batch measure_batch ON measure_batch.liquid_preparation_plan_batch_id = plan_batch.id LEFT JOIN bm_product_formula_material formula_material ON plan_batch.formula_material_id = formula_material.id WHERE plan_batch.is_deleted = 0 and plan_batch.liquid_preparation_plan_id = #{preparationPlanId}
